column1: # Draft v0.1 — declarative source interpretation; not a canonical-entity assignment table
# Entity resolution (known/synonym/unknown/provisional) occurs downstream in Entity Management.
# CORE / ASSOCIATED / RESIDUAL are information classes; operation is a separate processing disposition.

column15: rule
Identify the originating source as Tango Time Travel; do not replace native source provenance with an external reference.
column16: TTT source collection and existing source-profile work

column15: Preserve the complete original source path; the file is an asset, not the recording itself.
Preserve hierarchy as source evidence; extract semantic values only where a TTT hierarchy rule is established.
Create a Source Collection assertion from a recognized TTT collection node; retain the original path.
Retain filename verbatim; decode sequence/title/take components only where the filename grammar rule matches.
Carry the TTT title as a source assertion for the composition/title identity; do not treat title equality as entity identity.
Split explicit 'con' syntax into ensemble candidate and participating person candidate; retain the raw artist value.
Create a participating Person candidate from the component after explicit 'con'; do not infer a more specific role unless separately evidenced.
Recognize Instr. as an instrumental-status indicator, not as a person.

column4: ordinary artist value without recognized compound grammar
column15: Retain unresolved artist text as a source assertion rather than forcing an entity interpretation.
Preserve album_artist as source evidence; use it as corroborating ensemble evidence rather than assuming it establishes leadership.
Create one Person credit candidate per semicolon-delimited composer value; preserve ordering and raw field.
Split individual credit candidates; source field supplies the initial role semantics, which remain subject to entity/role reconciliation.
Extract parenthetical text as identity/name evidence; do not create a separate Person solely because of parentheses.
Decode recognized labeled components into separate identifier assertions; preserve the complete original catalog value.
Preserve the record component as an identifier assertion; do not equate it automatically with a Recording entity.
Preserve matrix number as identity evidence; do not collapse it into a recording ID without reconciliation.
Preserve take number as a separate concept; do not assume it uniquely identifies a recording.
Represent the supplied date with its supported precision; do not manufacture precision.
Preserve the TTT genre value and map it only through an explicit vocabulary crosswalk; do not collapse TTT's richer vocabulary to a downstream DJ vocabulary.
column16: TTT genre inventory; Common Model architecture

column15: Resolve as a Person candidate only when TTT context establishes that the performer is a person; retain source wording.
Create a Person candidate with conductor credit; entity resolution remains downstream.
Map through MusicStewardship media vocabulary while preserving the original TTT value.
Treat album as a Release/package context, not as recording identity.
Preserve source track position within the release context.
Parse only recognized structured clauses; retain the complete raw comment verbatim and preserve unmatched clauses as residual.
Extract pitch information when the recognized clause grammar matches; retain raw comment.
Extract supplied key as an assertion; do not assume it is the score key.
Extract score-key information separately from performance/asset key.
Normalize YES/NO while retaining the original source value.
Normalize instrumental status; this is a property of the performance representation, not a Person entity.
Preserve technical properties as properties of the Source Asset; they do not define the Recording entity.
Retain as external corroborating evidence; never make reference matching an acceptance gate.
Keep external values as separate evidence; native TTT values remain primary source-derived evidence.

column4: anything not covered by an established rule
column15: Do not discard. Preserve the original value and identify it as residual/uninterpreted until a future rule accounts for it.
